meta.name: add-dial-tool
meta.description: Give chosen NanoClaw agents a real phone number as a container tool — the `dial` CLI baked into the agent image plus OneCLI credential injection for api.getdial.ai, scoped per agent, so the agents you pick can send SMS, place AI voice calls, and receive verification codes from inside the sandbox. Independent of the Dial channel; idempotent; re-run to change which agents may use it. Use when the user wants agents to text, call, or run `dial …` from a chat, without wiring Dial as a messaging channel.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 给选中的代理配上真实电话号码，就能从聊天里发短信、打电话、收验证码。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你想让你手下的代理能直接发短信、打电话或接收验证码。
copy.tagline_en: Give chosen agents a phone number for SMS, calls, and verification codes.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage agents that need to text, call, or receive verification codes.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会给选中的 NanoClaw 代理装好 dial 命令行工具并注入 Dial 账号凭据,让这些代理能发短信、拨打 AI 语音电话、接收验证码;未选中的代理会被网关拦截,返回 403。
howto.when: 当用户想让代理发短信、打电话,或让它在聊天里直接运行 `dial` 命令,且不把 Dial 配成消息通道时,会触发该技能。

say.text: 给我的销售代理开启 Dial,让它能发短信和打电话。
say.note: 选中对应代理组,注入凭据并移除阻止。

say.text: 把 Dial 工具加到所有代理,但先不要授权任何代理。
say.note: 安装工具,所有代理暂时被阻止。

say.text: 让 `ag-xyz` 这个代理也能接收验证码。
say.note: 把该代理加入授权列表。

howto.what_en: Selected NanoClaw agents get the `dial` CLI plus an OneCLI credential for api.getdial.ai, so they can send SMS, place AI voice calls, and get verification codes in the sandbox. Unselected agents are blocked and get 403 blocked_by_policy.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user wants agents to text, call, or run `dial …` from a chat, without wiring Dial as a messaging channel.

say_en.text: Give my sales agent Dial so it can send texts and make calls.
say_en.note: Adds the agent to the allowed list, injects the credential.

say_en.text: Install Dial for all agents but block everyone for now.
say_en.note: Installs the tool with every agent blocked.

say_en.text: Let agent ag-xyz receive verification codes too.
say_en.note: Adds that agent to the Dial-enabled list.
